subject: Post-call: on-prem/VPC constraints and pilot scope — next steps
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@averylabs.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks + follow-up items from today's infra call

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking the time today — good call. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying points so we can align on feasibility:

Pain points / constraints
- Data residency: all customer PII must be processed and stored within the EU region (we cannot egress PII to the US).
- Air-gap requirement: for regulated batches we need an on-prem processing path with no direct internet egress; files are staged on an internal SFTP and processed in an isolated network.
- Network controls: strict port allowlist, no outbound DNS to public resolvers; only specific egress to partner IPs is allowed during maintenance windows.
- HSM/KMS: keys must be managed by our HSM (Thales) — redwood must support either an HSM integration or customer-managed key proxy.
- Auditability: long retention for audit logs (7 years), and access must be logged with SSO/SAML identity mapping.

Goals we want from Redwood
1) Clear documented network port matrix and egress profile for both a VPC-hosted private deployment and an on-prem air-gapped appliance.
2) A suggested deployment model and estimate for a pilot (12-week PoC) that meets the air-gap constraints.
3) A short SOW draft and high-level runbook for maintenance/failover.

Next steps (from our side)
- I'll loop in security and procurement after you share the port list and SOW.
- Procurement timeframe: expecting an internal decision within 6–8 weeks once we have an SOW and security attestation.

Thanks — Maria

Maria Gomez
CTO, Avery Labs
maria.gomez@averylabs.com
+44 20 5555 1234
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@averylabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks + follow-up items from today's infra call

Hi Maria — really appreciate the clear list. TL;DR: we can support both a VPC private tenancy (EU-only) and an on-prem air-gapped deployment; we'll need to confirm a few operational details.

Recap (confirming we captured everything)
- EU-only data residency for production PII: confirmed — we can pin to EU region and disable cross-region replication for customer data.
- Air-gap/on-prem processing: supported via our on-prem appliance bundle; it runs without outbound internet access and communicates with the control plane over a customer-controlled VPN/one-way bridge when allowed.
- HSM: we support external KMS/HSM integrations via our connector or by proxying requests through a customer-managed key proxy (both options require a short security integration workshop).
- Network & ports: we'll provide a conservative ports/egress matrix for both deployment types.
- Audit logs and retention: our audit export supports configurable retention — we'll include details on format and delivery (SIEM-forwarding options).

Immediate next steps (Redwood owner in parentheses)
1) Deliver network port + egress matrix for VPC and on-prem (Ben) — attached: redwood-onprem-network-ports.csv
2) Share a 2-page pilot SOW + runbook draft (Priyom) — attached: redwood-deployment-sow-draft.pdf
3) Book a technical workshop with your security/networking team to walk through HSM/port constraints (Naomi).
4) Provide a checklist of what the on-prem appliance requires physically (power, rack units, offline media) and suggested maintenance windows (Ben).

Can you confirm the security contact we should invite to the workshop? Also let us know which week (Aug 7–11 or Aug 14–18) is better for a 90-minute session.

Thanks again — we'll prioritize the port matrix and SOW and aim to have them to you by EOD Monday (Jul 23).

Best,

Naomi Feldman
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
